correctness.rationale: Rank reversal maps W→−W and R→R, proving Cov(W,R)=0 without independence. Conditioning J_t=1 selects one of the adjacent two ranks with probability 1/2 and leaves a uniformly random (a−1)-subset among N−2 others; finite-population variance of this subset plus independent pair orientation yields exactly the displayed local quadratic correction in (t−N/2)². The exact identity sum_{t=1}^{N−1}(t−N/2)²=(N−1)N(N−2)/12 cancels the local correction, leaving −ab(ab−1)/(3N). The case N=3 is checked by direct three-word enumeration, with −2/9. Since ab>=2 for N>=3, strict negative sign holds. Independently enumerated every composition N=3..11 with exact rational arithmetic (54 composition cases) and all J_t local profiles N=4..11; all match. Finite enumeration is corroboration only.
